A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
it is a study of the moral values embodied in the design of the social networking site Facebook.
the ethics of social media is a complex issue, and that there is no clear consensus on what constitutes ethical behavior.
we have shown the importance of a disclosive approach to ethics in the context of social networking sites.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the social networking sites are not just a place for socializing and entertainment but they are also a source of moral values.
Facebook is an ethical actor in its own right, and that its ethics are not reducible to those of its users.
